title: Concept: Dart dependency fetched from a git remote
description: pubspec.yaml declares a pubspec dependency sourced from git, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The code sits outside pub.dev's publication controls, so the hosted checksum model does not apply to it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pubspec.yaml (pub).
risk: The code sits outside pub.dev's publication controls, so the hosted checksum model does not apply to it.
